quienesSomos.heading: We think, design, build, and operate industrial facilities aligned with efficiency criteria and optimized according to the needs of each context.

items.label: Engineering [E]
items.text: We develop engineering across all phases: Conceptual, Basic, and Detailed Engineering, as well as Special Studies, Cost Estimation, and Project Evaluation.

items.label: Modular Plants and Equipment [EP]
items.text: We design and manufacture modular process plants and equipment.

items.label: Turnkey Plants [EPC]
items.text: We design, manufacture, and build turnkey process plants.

items.label: Project Management [EPCm / OE]
items.text: We provide comprehensive project management: Owner's Engineering, Procurement Management, Contract Management, Quality Management, Technical Office, and Field Supervision.

items.label: Operation and Maintenance [O&M]
items.text: We provide process plant operation services for third parties, technical support to operations, and pre-commissioning, commissioning, and start-up services.

items.label: Well Testing
items.text: Measurement and analysis service for the variables associated with well production.

items.label: Oil and Gas Processing Services
items.text: We provide oil and gas processing services for third parties using our own equipment.

items.label: NGL and LPG Processing and Commercialization
items.text: We process NGL (Natural Gas Liquids) and LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) streams to bring them to commercial value for subsequent sale.

comoTrabajamos.intro: We commit to the objectives of each project by making the business perspective our own, this is our philosophy:
paragraphs: We develop and integrate complex process technologies, ensuring the most suitable solution for each project.
We apply knowledge and analytical capability to solve every challenge.
We maintain a high degree of vendor independence (technology-agnostic).
We work in accordance with the standards of each industry and each operator. We adapt to the context of each project.

values.title: Passion and Commitment
values.description: We fulfill the commitments we make, building trust and long-term relationships with our clients.

values.title: Reliability and Innovation
values.description: We seek to think “out of the box” to bring new solutions to our clients. We are comfortable working from a blank page.

values.title: Agility
values.description: We do things with dynamism and speed under the highest standards of quality, safety, and environmental care.

values.title: Teamwork
values.description: We know that peak performance is achieved only by empowering collaborative teamwork.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: We rely on internal and external information to accurately communicate our defined strategic objectives and the path to achieve them.

values.title: Honesty
values.description: We carry out all our activities with honesty in our relationships with our employees, collaborators, clients, and other stakeholders.

unite.heading: Join Us in Creating the Energy of the Future

cards.title: Challenges and Learning
cards.description: We work in an industry that constantly challenges us to innovate. Every project is an opportunity to learn, improve, and grow through action.

cards.title: Collaborative Work
cards.description: We connect, share knowledge, and work as a network. Technology and collaboration enhance results and allow us to work in an agile, digital way.

cards.title: Diversity and Innovation
cards.description: Diversity drives our creativity. We value different perspectives and experiences, because the best ideas emerge from their intersection.

cards.title: Own the Business
cards.description: We are passionate about what we do and understand the impact of our work. At Spark, every person knows the business and contributes to building a comprehensive vision.
